app.title: Install Sloth OS
welcome.heading: Welcome to Sloth OS!
welcome.text: You can try the system without installing it, or install it on your computer. Installing takes a few minutes and just a few questions.
region.heading: Keyboard and time zone
region.try_keyboard_hint: Type here to check the layout
region.note: You can change these later in System Settings.
account.heading: Create your account
account.text: You'll sign in to the computer with this name and password. Your account will be an administrator, so you can also change the computer's settings.
account.note: You can choose what the computer asks your password for on first start, in Sloth Welcome.
account.error.name: Enter your name.
account.error.username: The username can only contain lowercase English letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores, and must start with a letter (e.g. “anna”).
disk.heading: Where should we install it?
disk.text: Choose the disk Sloth OS will be installed on.
disk.none: We couldn't find a disk to install on.
disk.too_small: Too small: at least 40 GB is needed.
disk.contents.linux: Has a Linux system on it
disk.removable: This is an external drive (e.g. a USB stick). Are you sure you want to install here?
disk.small: A bit tight: at least 120 GB is recommended for games.
confirm.heading: Everything on this disk will be erased
confirm.text: Sloth OS uses the whole disk: {disk}. Everything on it now (files, programs, other systems) will be permanently deleted.
confirm.windows: This disk has Windows on it. After installing, Windows and all its files will be gone. If you want to keep them, back up your files first.
confirm.checkbox: I understand that all data on the disk will be erased
stage.copy: Copying Sloth OS to the disk…
install.note: Depending on your computer, this takes 5–20 minutes. Please don't turn it off.
done.heading: Installation complete!
done.text: Restart your computer. When the screen goes dark, unplug the USB stick. Then sign in with the account you just created, and Sloth Welcome will help with the rest.
error.heading: Installation failed
error.log_hint: If you ask for help, the details are in /tmp/sloth-install.log.
error.not_authorized: We didn't get permission to install.
error.bad_disk: This disk can't be installed on. Please choose another one.
error.bad_input: One of the settings is invalid. Go back and check them.
error.install_failed: Something went wrong while copying the system to the disk. Data previously on the disk may already have been erased.
error.configure_failed: The system was installed, but setting the language and keyboard failed. Try again; if it still fails, you can set them in System Settings after the first start.
